description: This file is a Java class implementing a REST controller for managing Task entities, providing CRUD API endpoints.

classes.name: TaskController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller handling CRUD operations for tasks, including endpoints to list, retrieve, create, update, and delete tasks.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a Task entity to a TaskResponse DTO for API response.

methods.name: listTasks
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to list all tasks.

methods.name: getTask
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a single task by ID.

methods.name: createTask
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new task.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update an existing task by ID.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to delete a task by ID.
